description: Wi-Fi is a dataset listed in Boulogne-Billancourt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Boulogne-Billancourt - Direction des Systèmes d'Information - Service Production, Infrastructure et Cloud (P.I.C.). Emplacement des équipements municipaux disposant d'un accès Wi-Fi ouvert. Coverage: Boulogne-Billancourt. The portal files it under Environnement, Cadre de vie. Its keywords are wifi. The portal shows 23 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-07-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-boulognebillancourt-seineouest-portal.
